post.description: Captions a short, finished video, such as an AI-generated one, frames it Fit (the whole frame) or Center (a centered cover crop), and exports it at each requested format. There is no clip detection: the Project gets one clip, the whole video, up to 3 minutes. Captions come from the speech (auto), from SRT or WebVTT you supply, or are omitted (none); a video without an audio stream gets no speech captions. Send a link to import it (202), or describe a file to open an Upload Session that carries these settings (200), upload it, and finalize it with POST /uploads/{id}/finalize. Follow the work with GET /operations/{id}: its results name the export, and its notices report framing_degraded when Center crops part of the frame.

get.description: Polls what finished in this Workspace, including work no request started, such as an Autopilot import. Events are ordered by seq; pass the returned nextCursor as `after`. Delivery is at least once, so deduplicate by event id. Events expire after 30 days; re-sync from the list endpoints if a poller was down longer. order=desc returns the newest events, newest first, for pollers that read the newest page each time and deduplicate by id: at most limit (200) matching events per poll interval. Queue proposals (social_post.proposed) and posting outcomes (social_post.finished) need the publishing:read scope: a request that names only those types without it is refused with scope_required, and one that mixes them with other types gets the other types.
